# Callouts: Recovery 3.1 - boot-loader session: the seven probes

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec3-1_wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec3-1_wiring.jpg)

Supply on JP5, the USB-serial adapter on J29 (its TXD through 1 kΩ), the strap from U15 pin 8 through 470 Ω onto X6, the SOP2 pad. The cable stays out of J8. Swap the two J29 signal probes if chapter 1 found hole 2 to be TX.
